definitions.explanation: Indicates that something applies to an additional item or person. Replaces は, が, or を. {私|わたし}も{行|い}きます (I'll go too).
Emphasizes an extreme or unexpected case. {子供|こども}でも{分|わ}かる (even a child can understand).
Used in pairs to mean 'both' (AもBも) or with negatives for 'neither.' {犬|いぬ}も{猫|ねこ}も{好|す}き (I like both dogs and cats).

definitions.gloss: as many as, as much as
definitions.explanation: Emphasizes a large quantity. {三時間|さんじかん}も{待|ま}った (waited for as long as 3 hours).

particle_behavior.description: も replaces some particles but attaches after others

replaces.before: {私|わたし}は{学生|がくせい}です
replaces.after: {私|わたし}も{学生|がくせい}です

attaches_after.example: {東京|とうきょう}にも{行|い}った
{家|いえ}でも{勉強|べんきょう}する
{友達|ともだち}とも{話|はな}した
{終点|しゅうてん}までも{行|い}った
attaches_after.meaning: went even as far as the terminus

patterns.example: どこも{行|い}かなかった
いつも{早|はや}く{起|お}きる

patterns.example_english: I don't want any of them

particle_contrasts.explanation: は marks topic/contrast; も adds to a set

examples.mo_example: {田中|たなか}さんも{来|き}ました
examples.mo_note: も: adding to those who came

examples.ha_example: {田中|たなか}さんは{来|き}ました

particle_contrasts.explanation: Both can mean 'even,' but も is simpler inclusion while まで emphasizes surprising extent

examples.mo_example: {子供|こども}も{知|し}っている

examples.made_example: {子供|こども}まで{知|し}っている

fixed_patterns.example: {肉|にく}も{魚|さかな}も{好|す}きです
fixed_patterns.example_english: I like both meat and fish

fixed_patterns.example: {肉|にく}も{魚|さかな}も{食|た}べません
fixed_patterns.example_english: I eat neither meat nor fish

fixed_patterns.example: {雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}っても{行|い}く
fixed_patterns.example_english: I'll go even if it rains

fixed_patterns.example: コーヒーでも{飲|の}みませんか
fixed_patterns.example_english: Would you like to have some coffee or something?

fixed_patterns.example: {三回|さんかい}も{失敗|しっぱい}した
fixed_patterns.example_english: failed as many as three times

fixed_patterns.example: {一人|ひとり}も{来|こ}なかった

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}も{日本語|にほんご}を{勉強|べんきょう}しています。
これも{買|か}いたいです。
examples.english: I want to buy this too.

examples.japanese: {誰|だれ}も{来|き}ませんでした。
{お茶|おちゃ}もコーヒーもあります。
examples.english: We have both tea and coffee.
examples.notes: AもBも = both A and B

examples.japanese: {三時間|さんじかん}も{待|ま}ちました。
examples.english: I waited for as long as three hours.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}にも{行|い}きました。

common_mistakes.mistake: Using も instead of は for topic
common_mistakes.context: {私|わたし}も{田中|たなか}です (I'm also Tanaka) vs {私|わたし}は{田中|たなか}です (I'm Tanaka)
common_mistakes.explanation: も implies addition; use は for simple topic
も replaces を, doesn't attach after it

common_mistakes.mistake: Forgetting negative with question word patterns
common_mistakes.incorrect: {誰|だれ}も{来|き}ました (Everyone came? - actually means 'did anyone come?')
common_mistakes.correct: {誰|だれ}も{来|こ}なかった (Nobody came) or {皆|みんな}{来|き}ました (Everyone came)
common_mistakes.explanation: {誰|だれ}も with negative = nobody; for 'everyone' use {皆|みんな} or {誰|だれ}でも

notes: も replaces は, が, and を but attaches after other particles: に→にも, で→でも, と→とも. With question words and negatives: {誰|だれ}も...ない (nobody), {何|なに}も...ない (nothing), どこも...ない (nowhere). These patterns are essential for expressing 'nobody/nothing/nowhere.'
